			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/liuziyi1/p/23572132" title="发布于 2026-11-06 11:41">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SQL Server 2012–2022 运维巡检500条完整速查手册（建议收藏）</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>以下按 <strong>SQL Server 2012–2022（Windows / Linux）</strong> 整理，共 500 条，按 14 类连续编号。默认以 <code>sqlcmd</code> 执行 T-SQL；标注“2016+ / 2017+ / 2019+”的条目需目标版本支持，低版本请跳过或改用等价 DMV。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>说明：数据库名、文件路径、登录名等请替换为实际值；生产环境执行 <code>DBCC</code>、<code>RESTORE</code>、<code>SHRINK</code> 类命令前先评估影响。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="一实例与版本基础信息135">一、实例与版本基础信息（1–35）</h2>
<ol>
<li>查看完整版本：<code>SELECT @@VERSION;</code></li>
<li>版本号/补丁级别/版本类型：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS product_version, SERVERPROPERTY('ProductLevel') AS product_level, SERVERPROPERTY('Edition') AS edition, SERVERPROPERTY('EngineEdition') AS engine_edition;</code></li>
<li>实例名与主机名：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ServerName') AS server_name, SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceName') AS instance_name, SERVERPROPERTY('MachineName') AS machine_name;</code></li>
<li>实例排序规则：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('Collation') AS server_collation, DATABASEPROPERTYEX(N'master', N'Collation') AS master_collation;</code></li>
<li>是否集群/是否启用 AlwaysOn：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('IsClustered') AS is_clustered, SERVERPROPERTY('IsHadrEnabled') AS is_hadr_enabled;</code></li>
<li>启动时间与运行时长：<code>SELECT sqlserver_start_time, DATEDIFF(HOUR, sqlserver_start_time, GETDATE()) AS uptime_hours FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;</code></li>
<li>CPU 核数与调度器：<code>SELECT cpu_count, scheduler_count, max_workers_count, hyperthread_ratio FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;</code></li>
<li>物理内存与提交内存：<code>SELECT physical_memory_kb/1024 AS physical_mb, committed_kb/1024 AS committed_mb, committed_target_kb/1024 AS target_mb FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;</code></li>
<li>进程工作集与大页内存：<code>SELECT physical_memory_in_use_kb/1024 AS working_set_mb, large_page_allocations_kb/1024 AS large_page_mb, locked_page_allocations_kb/1024 AS locked_page_mb FROM sys.dm_os_process_memory;</code></li>
<li>服务状态：<code>SELECT servicename, startup_type_desc, status_desc, service_account, last_startup_time, is_clustered FROM sys.dm_server_services;</code></li>
<li>服务可执行文件路径：<code>SELECT servicename, filename FROM sys.dm_server_services;</code></li>
<li>实例注册表信息：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_server_registry WHERE registry_key LIKE N'%MSSQLServer%';</code></li>
<li>数据库清单：<code>SELECT name, database_id, state_desc, recovery_model_desc, compatibility_level, collation_name FROM sys.databases ORDER BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>数据库状态统计：<code>SELECT state_desc, COUNT(*) AS db_count FROM sys.databases GROUP BY state_desc;</code></li>
<li>兼容级别分布：<code>SELECT compatibility_level, COUNT(*) AS db_count FROM sys.databases GROUP BY compatibility_level;</code></li>
<li>实例配置概览：<code>SELECT name, value, value_in_use, is_dynamic, is_advanced FROM sys.configurations ORDER BY name;</code></li>
<li>启动参数：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_server_registry WHERE registry_key LIKE N'%Parameters%';</code></li>
<li>错误日志路径：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ErrorLogFileName') AS errorlog_path;</code></li>
<li>默认备份目录：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceDefaultBackupPath') AS backup_path;</code></li>
<li>默认数据/日志目录：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceDefaultDataPath') AS data_path, SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceDefaultLogPath') AS log_path;</code></li>
<li>当前连接端口与加密：<code>SELECT local_tcp_port, net_transport, auth_scheme, encrypt_option FROM sys.dm_exec_connections WHERE session_id = @@SPID;</code></li>
<li>TCP 端点：<code>SELECT name, protocol_desc, type_desc, port, is_admin_endpoint FROM sys.tcp_endpoints;</code></li>
<li>端点状态：<code>SELECT name, protocol_desc, state_desc, is_admin_endpoint FROM sys.endpoints;</code></li>
<li>当前会话身份：<code>SELECT @@SPID AS spid, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, DB_NAME() AS dbname, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name;</code></li>
<li>本地时间与 UTC：<code>SELECT SYSDATETIME() AS local_time, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AS local_offset, GETUTCDATE() AS utc_time;</code></li>
<li>语言与区域：<code>SELECT @@LANGUAGE AS language, SERVERPROPERTY('LCID') AS lcid;</code></li>
<li>授权信息：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('LicenseType') AS license_type, SERVERPROPERTY('NumLicenses') AS num_licenses;</code></li>
<li>引擎形态（5=Azure SQL DB，8=托管实例）：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('EngineEdition') AS engine_edition;</code></li>
<li>资源调控器配置：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.resource_governor_configuration;</code></li>
<li>资源池：<code>SELECT pool_id, name, min_cpu_percent, max_cpu_percent, cap_cpu_percent, min_memory_percent, max_memory_percent FROM sys.dm_resource_governor_resource_pools;</code></li>
<li>工作负载组：<code>SELECT group_id, name, pool_id, importance, max_dop FROM sys.dm_resource_governor_workload_groups;</code></li>
<li>跟踪标志状态：<code>DBCC TRACESTATUS(-1) WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>用户连接上限：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'user connections';</code></li>
<li>最大工作线程：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'max worker threads';</code></li>
<li>会话总数与用户会话数：<code>SELECT COUNT(*) AS session_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_user_process = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS user_sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions;</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="二配置参数与实例设置3670">二、配置参数与实例设置（36–70）</h2>
<ol start="36">
<li>最小/最大服务器内存：<code>SELECT name, value, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name IN (N'min server memory (MB)', N'max server memory (MB)');</code></li>
<li>最大并行度：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'max degree of parallelism';</code></li>
<li>并行开销阈值：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'cost threshold for parallelism';</code></li>
<li>即席工作负载优化：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'optimize for ad hoc workloads';</code></li>
<li>默认备份压缩：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'backup compression default';</code></li>
<li>恢复间隔：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'recovery interval (min)';</code></li>
<li>远程登录超时：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'remote login timeout (s)';</code></li>
<li>远程查询超时：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'remote query timeout (s)';</code></li>
<li>最大锁数：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'locks';</code></li>
<li>阻塞进程阈值：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'blocked process threshold (s)';</code></li>
<li>默认跟踪：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'default trace enabled';</code></li>
<li>网络包大小：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'network packet size (B)';</code></li>
<li>默认填充因子：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'fill factor (%)';</code></li>
<li>轻量池：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'lightweight pooling';</code></li>
<li>优先级提升：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'priority boost';</code></li>
<li>自动创建统计信息：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'auto create statistics';</code></li>
<li>自动更新统计信息：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'auto update statistics';</code></li>
<li>异步更新统计信息：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'auto update statistics asynchronously';</code></li>
<li>游标阈值：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'cursor threshold';</code></li>
<li>嵌套触发器：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'nested triggers';</code></li>
<li>递归触发器：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'recursive triggers';</code></li>
<li>CLR 启用状态：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'clr enabled';</code></li>
<li>即席分布式查询：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'Ad Hoc Distributed Queries';</code></li>
<li>xp_cmdshell 状态：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'xp_cmdshell';</code></li>
<li>OLE 自动化：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'Ole Automation Procedures';</code></li>
<li>数据库邮件：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'Database Mail XPs';</code></li>
<li>代理扩展：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'Agent XPs';</code></li>
<li>高级选项可见性：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'show advanced options';</code></li>
<li>全文检索是否安装：<code>SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('IsFullTextInstalled') AS is_fulltext_installed;</code></li>
<li>运行值与配置值不一致项：<code>SELECT name, value, value_in_use, is_dynamic FROM sys.configurations WHERE value &lt;&gt; value_in_use;</code></li>
<li>服务账号与权限核对：<code>SELECT servicename, service_account FROM sys.dm_server_services WHERE servicename LIKE N'SQL Server%';</code></li>
<li>默认跟踪中的配置/对象变更：<code>DECLARE @p nvarchar(260); SELECT @p = CAST(value AS nvarchar(260)) FROM sys.fn_trace_getinfo(NULL) WHERE traceid = 1 AND property = 2; SELECT * FROM sys.fn_trace_gettable(@p, DEFAULT) WHERE EventClass IN (46,47,164,92,93,94,95);</code></li>
<li>最大内存占物理内存比例：<code>SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS decimal(10,2))*100.0/(physical_memory_kb/1024) AS max_mem_pct FROM sys.configurations CROSS JOIN sys.dm_os_sys_info WHERE name = N'max server memory (MB)';</code></li>
<li>并行相关配置组合：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name IN (N'max degree of parallelism', N'cost threshold for parallelism', N'max worker threads');</code></li>
<li>高风险安全配置组合：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name IN (N'xp_cmdshell', N'Ole Automation Procedures', N'Ad Hoc Distributed Queries', N'clr enabled');</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="三数据库状态与容量空间71110">三、数据库状态与容量空间（71–110）</h2>
<ol start="71">
<li>数据库状态总览：<code>SELECT name, state_desc, user_access_desc, is_read_only, is_in_standby FROM sys.databases ORDER BY name;</code></li>
<li>非在线数据库：<code>SELECT name, state_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE state &lt;&gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>只读数据库：<code>SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE is_read_only = 1;</code></li>
<li>自动关闭数据库：<code>SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE is_auto_close_on = 1;</code></li>
<li>自动收缩数据库：<code>SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE is_auto_shrink_on = 1;</code></li>
<li>页面校验方式：<code>SELECT name, page_verify_option_desc FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>快照隔离状态：<code>SELECT name, snapshot_isolation_state_desc FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>已提交读快照：<code>SELECT name, is_read_committed_snapshot_on FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>延迟持久化（2014+）：<code>SELECT name, delayed_durability_desc FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>包含数据库：<code>SELECT name, containment_desc FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>用户访问模式：<code>SELECT name, user_access_desc FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>数据库完整属性：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.databases ORDER BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>数据库总大小排名：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, SUM(size)*8/1024 AS total_mb FROM sys.master_files GROUP BY database_id ORDER BY total_mb DESC;</code></li>
<li>数据文件大小：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, size*8/1024 AS size_mb FROM sys.master_files WHERE type_desc = N'ROWS';</code></li>
<li>日志文件大小：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, size*8/1024 AS size_mb FROM sys.master_files WHERE type_desc = N'LOG';</code></li>
<li>每库数据与日志汇总：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, SUM(CASE WHEN type_desc = N'ROWS' THEN size END)*8/1024 AS data_mb, SUM(CASE WHEN type_desc = N'LOG' THEN size END)*8/1024 AS log_mb FROM sys.master_files GROUP BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>文件已用与剩余空间：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, size*8/1024 AS size_mb, FILEPROPERTY(name,'SpaceUsed')*8/1024 AS used_mb, (size-FILEPROPERTY(name,'SpaceUsed'))*8/1024 AS free_mb FROM sys.master_files;</code></li>
<li>文件空间使用率：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, CAST(FILEPROPERTY(name,'SpaceUsed')*100.0/NULLIF(size,0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS used_pct FROM sys.master_files;</code></li>
<li>卷剩余空间：<code>SELECT DISTINCT DB_NAME(mf.database_id) AS dbname, vs.volume_mount_point, vs.total_bytes/1073741824 AS total_gb, vs.available_bytes/1073741824 AS free_gb FROM sys.master_files mf CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(mf.database_id, mf.file_id) vs;</code></li>
<li>卷剩余百分比：<code>SELECT DISTINCT vs.volume_mount_point, CAST(100.0*vs.available_bytes/NULLIF(vs.total_bytes,0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS free_pct FROM sys.master_files mf CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(mf.database_id, mf.file_id) vs;</code></li>
<li>tempdb 总大小：<code>SELECT SUM(size)*8/1024 AS tempdb_mb FROM tempdb.sys.database_files;</code></li>
<li>tempdb 文件明细：<code>SELECT name, physical_name, size*8/1024 AS size_mb, growth, is_percent_growth FROM tempdb.sys.database_files;</code></li>
<li>tempdb 版本存储空间：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_tran_version_store_space_usage;</code></li>
<li>tempdb 会话占用：<code>SELECT session_id, user_objects_alloc_page_count*8/1024 AS user_mb, internal_objects_alloc_page_count*8/1024 AS internal_mb FROM tempdb.sys.dm_db_session_space_usage ORDER BY user_objects_alloc_page_count DESC;</code></li>
<li>tempdb 任务占用：<code>SELECT session_id, request_id, user_objects_alloc_page_count*8/1024 AS user_mb, internal_objects_alloc_page_count*8/1024 AS internal_mb FROM tempdb.sys.dm_db_task_space_usage ORDER BY internal_objects_alloc_page_count DESC;</code></li>
<li>表空间占用 Top20：<code>SELECT TOP 20 OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(p.object_id)+'.'+OBJECT_NAME(p.object_id) AS table_name, SUM(p.used_page_count)*8/1024 AS used_mb FROM sys.dm_db_partition_stats p GROUP BY p.object_id ORDER BY used_mb DESC;</code></li>
<li>表行数 Top20：<code>SELECT TOP 20 OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(object_id)+'.'+OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, SUM(row_count) AS row_count FROM sys.dm_db_partition_stats WHERE index_id IN (0,1) GROUP BY object_id ORDER BY row_count DESC;</code></li>
<li>分区行数与页数：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, partition_number, row_count, used_page_count FROM sys.dm_db_partition_stats WHERE index_id IN (0,1) ORDER BY object_id, partition_number;</code></li>
<li>分配单元统计：<code>SELECT type_desc, COUNT(*) AS allocation_units, SUM(total_pages)*8/1024 AS total_mb FROM sys.allocation_units GROUP BY type_desc;</code></li>
<li>文件最大大小设置：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, max_size, CASE WHEN max_size = -1 THEN 'UNLIMITED' WHEN max_size = 0 THEN 'NOGROWTH' ELSE CAST(max_size*8/1024 AS varchar(20))+' MB' END AS max_size_desc FROM sys.master_files;</code></li>
<li>文件增长设置：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, growth, is_percent_growth FROM sys.master_files;</code></li>
<li>百分比增长或禁止增长：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, growth, is_percent_growth FROM sys.master_files WHERE is_percent_growth = 1 OR growth = 0;</code></li>
<li>文件所在卷：<code>SELECT DISTINCT DB_NAME(mf.database_id) AS dbname, mf.name, vs.volume_mount_point FROM sys.master_files mf CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(mf.database_id, mf.file_id) vs;</code></li>
<li>日志空间使用（所有库）：<code>DBCC SQLPERF(LOGSPACE) WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>日志空间 DMV：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, total_log_size_in_bytes/1048576 AS total_mb, used_log_space_in_bytes/1048576 AS used_mb, used_log_space_in_percent FROM sys.dm_db_log_space_usage;</code></li>
<li>VLF 数量与大小（2016 SP2+）：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, COUNT(*) AS vlf_count, SUM(vlf_size_mb) AS vlf_total_mb FROM sys.dm_db_log_info(NULL) GROUP BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>日志统计（2016 SP2+）：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, recovery_model, total_vlf_count, active_vlf_count, active_log_size_mb, log_truncation_holdup_reason FROM sys.dm_db_log_stats(NULL);</code></li>
<li>日志截断等待原因：<code>SELECT name, log_reuse_wait_desc FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>VLF 明细：<code>DBCC LOGINFO WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>数据库快照：<code>SELECT name, source_database_id, snapshot_isolation_state_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE source_database_id IS NOT NULL;</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="四文件日志与恢复模式管理111150">四、文件、日志与恢复模式管理（111–150）</h2>
<ol start="111">
<li>恢复模式总览：<code>SELECT name, recovery_model_desc FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>简单恢复模式业务库：<code>SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE recovery_model_desc = N'SIMPLE' AND database_id &gt; 4;</code></li>
<li>大容量日志模式库：<code>SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE recovery_model_desc = N'BULK_LOGGED';</code></li>
<li>完整模式但近 7 天无日志备份：<code>SELECT d.name FROM sys.databases d WHERE d.recovery_model_desc = N'FULL' AND d.database_id &gt; 4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs WHERE bs.database_name = d.name AND bs.type = 'L' AND bs.backup_finish_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()));</code></li>
<li>日志文件增长设置：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, growth, is_percent_growth FROM sys.master_files WHERE type_desc = N'LOG';</code></li>
<li>数据文件增长设置：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, growth, is_percent_growth FROM sys.master_files WHERE type_desc = N'ROWS';</code></li>
<li>百分比自动增长文件：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, growth FROM sys.master_files WHERE is_percent_growth = 1;</code></li>
<li>增长值小于 64MB：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, growth*8/1024 AS growth_mb FROM sys.master_files WHERE is_percent_growth = 0 AND growth &gt; 0 AND growth &lt; 8192;</code></li>
<li>无最大大小限制：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name FROM sys.master_files WHERE max_size = -1;</code></li>
<li>数据与日志同卷：<code>SELECT vs.volume_mount_point, COUNT(DISTINCT mf.type_desc) AS file_types FROM sys.master_files mf CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(mf.database_id, mf.file_id) vs GROUP BY vs.volume_mount_point HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mf.type_desc) &gt; 1;</code></li>
<li>文件物理路径清单：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, physical_name FROM sys.master_files;</code></li>
<li>文件组：<code>SELECT name, type_desc, is_default, is_read_only FROM sys.filegroups;</code></li>
<li>文件组与文件分布：<code>SELECT fg.name AS filegroup_name, mf.name AS file_name, mf.size*8/1024 AS size_mb FROM sys.filegroups fg JOIN sys.master_files mf ON fg.data_space_id = mf.data_space_id AND mf.database_id = DB_ID();</code></li>
<li>只读文件组：<code>SELECT name FROM sys.filegroups WHERE is_read_only = 1;</code></li>
<li>文件平均读延迟：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(vfs.database_id) AS dbname, mf.physical_name, CASE WHEN vfs.num_of_reads = 0 THEN 0 ELSE vfs.io_stall_read_ms/vfs.num_of_reads END AS avg_read_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) vfs JOIN sys.master_files mf ON vfs.database_id = mf.database_id AND vfs.file_id = mf.file_id ORDER BY avg_read_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>文件平均写延迟：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(vfs.database_id) AS dbname, mf.physical_name, CASE WHEN vfs.num_of_writes = 0 THEN 0 ELSE vfs.io_stall_write_ms/vfs.num_of_writes END AS avg_write_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) vfs JOIN sys.master_files mf ON vfs.database_id = mf.database_id AND vfs.file_id = mf.file_id ORDER BY avg_write_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>文件吞吐量：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(vfs.database_id) AS dbname, mf.physical_name, vfs.num_of_bytes_read/1048576 AS read_mb, vfs.num_of_bytes_written/1048576 AS write_mb FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) vfs JOIN sys.master_files mf ON vfs.database_id = mf.database_id AND vfs.file_id = mf.file_id ORDER BY vfs.io_stall DESC;</code></li>
<li>IO 等待最严重文件：<code>SELECT TOP 10 DB_NAME(vfs.database_id) AS dbname, mf.physical_name, vfs.io_stall AS total_stall_ms, vfs.io_stall_read_ms, vfs.io_stall_write_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) vfs JOIN sys.master_files mf ON vfs.database_id = mf.database_id AND vfs.file_id = mf.file_id ORDER BY vfs.io_stall DESC;</code></li>
<li>待处理 IO 请求：<code>SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_io, MAX(io_pending_ms_ticks) AS max_pending_ms FROM sys.dm_io_pending_io_requests;</code></li>
<li>文件 IO 按数据库汇总：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, SUM(num_of_reads) AS reads, SUM(num_of_writes) AS writes, SUM(io_stall) AS total_stall_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) GROUP BY database_id ORDER BY total_stall_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>可疑页数量：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, COUNT(*) AS suspect_pages FROM msdb.dbo.suspect_pages GROUP BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>文件只读/稀疏属性：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, is_media_read_only, is_read_only, is_sparse FROM sys.master_files;</code></li>
<li>缓冲池脏页总数：<code>SELECT COUNT(*) AS dirty_pages FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors WHERE is_modified = 1;</code></li>
<li>每库脏页数量：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, COUNT(*) AS dirty_pages FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors WHERE is_modified = 1 GROUP BY database_id ORDER BY dirty_pages DESC;</code></li>
<li>每库缓冲页占比：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, COUNT(*)*8/1024 AS cached_mb FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors GROUP BY database_id ORDER BY cached_mb DESC;</code></li>
<li>日志写入等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = N'WRITELOG';</code></li>
<li>日志文件刷新延迟：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(vfs.database_id) AS dbname, mf.physical_name, vfs.io_stall_write_ms, vfs.num_of_writes FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) vfs JOIN sys.master_files mf ON vfs.database_id = mf.database_id AND vfs.file_id = mf.file_id WHERE mf.type_desc = N'LOG' ORDER BY vfs.io_stall_write_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>日志自动增长事件：<code>DECLARE @p nvarchar(260); SELECT @p = CAST(value AS nvarchar(260)) FROM sys.fn_trace_getinfo(NULL) WHERE traceid = 1 AND property = 2; SELECT * FROM sys.fn_trace_gettable(@p, DEFAULT) WHERE EventClass = 93;</code></li>
<li>数据文件自动增长事件：<code>DECLARE @p nvarchar(260); SELECT @p = CAST(value AS nvarchar(260)) FROM sys.fn_trace_getinfo(NULL) WHERE traceid = 1 AND property = 2; SELECT * FROM sys.fn_trace_gettable(@p, DEFAULT) WHERE EventClass = 92;</code></li>
<li>文件自动收缩事件：<code>DECLARE @p nvarchar(260); SELECT @p = CAST(value AS nvarchar(260)) FROM sys.fn_trace_getinfo(NULL) WHERE traceid = 1 AND property = 2; SELECT * FROM sys.fn_trace_gettable(@p, DEFAULT) WHERE EventClass IN (94,95);</code></li>
<li>数据库所有者：<code>SELECT name, SUSER_SNAME(owner_sid) AS owner FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>数据库创建时间：<code>SELECT name, create_date FROM sys.databases ORDER BY create_date;</code></li>
<li>每库最后全备时间：<code>SELECT d.name, MAX(bs.backup_finish_date) AS last_full FROM sys.databases d LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs ON d.name = bs.database_name AND bs.type = 'D' GROUP BY d.name;</code></li>
<li>每库最后日志备份时间：<code>SELECT d.name, MAX(bs.backup_finish_date) AS last_log FROM sys.databases d LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs ON d.name = bs.database_name AND bs.type = 'L' GROUP BY d.name;</code></li>
<li>从未备份的数据库：<code>SELECT d.name FROM sys.databases d WHERE d.database_id &gt; 4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs WHERE bs.database_name = d.name AND bs.type = 'D');</code></li>
<li>备份链完整性检查：<code>SELECT d.name, MAX(CASE WHEN bs.type='D' THEN bs.backup_finish_date END) AS last_full, MAX(CASE WHEN bs.type='L' THEN bs.backup_finish_date END) AS last_log FROM sys.databases d LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs ON d.name = bs.database_name GROUP BY d.name HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN bs.type='D' THEN bs.backup_finish_date END) IS NULL OR MAX(CASE WHEN bs.type='L' THEN bs.backup_finish_date END) &lt; DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE());</code></li>
<li>恢复模式与备份策略匹配：<code>SELECT name, recovery_model_desc, log_reuse_wait_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE database_id &gt; 4;</code></li>
<li>数据库兼容级别：<code>SELECT name, compatibility_level FROM sys.databases ORDER BY compatibility_level;</code></li>
<li>数据库排序规则：<code>SELECT name, collation_name FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>排序规则与实例不一致：<code>SELECT name, collation_name FROM sys.databases WHERE collation_name &lt;&gt; CONVERT(sysname, SERVERPROPERTY('Collation'));</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="五错误日志与诊断日志151180">五、错误日志与诊断日志（151–180）</h2>
<ol start="151">
<li>读取当前错误日志：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>错误日志中的 Error 记录：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'Error', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>操作系统 I/O 错误：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'operating system error', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>内存相关错误：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'memory', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>登录失败：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'Login failed', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>死锁记录：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'deadlock', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>备份失败：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'BACKUP failed', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>损坏相关记录：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'corrupt', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>还原记录：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 1, N'RESTORE', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>错误日志轮转列表：<code>EXEC sys.xp_enumerrorlogs;</code></li>
<li>错误日志文件大小（Windows）：<code>Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server\MSSQL*\MSSQL\Log\ERRORLOG*' | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime</code>；Linux：<code>ls -lh /var/opt/mssql/log/errorlog*</code></li>
<li>默认跟踪文件：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.traces WHERE is_default = 1;</code></li>
<li>默认跟踪内容：<code>DECLARE @p nvarchar(260); SELECT @p = CAST(value AS nvarchar(260)) FROM sys.fn_trace_getinfo(NULL) WHERE traceid = 1 AND property = 2; SELECT * FROM sys.fn_trace_gettable(@p, DEFAULT);</code></li>
<li>Agent 错误日志：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 2, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>Agent 日志中的作业失败：<code>EXEC sys.xp_readerrorlog 0, 2, N'failed', NULL, NULL, NULL, N'DESC';</code></li>
<li>Windows 应用程序日志（MSSQLSERVER）：<code>Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; ProviderName='MSSQLSERVER'} -MaxEvents 100</code></li>
<li>Windows 系统日志：<code>Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 100</code></li>
<li>Linux 服务日志：<code>sudo journalctl -u mssql-server -n 200 --no-pager</code></li>
<li>Linux 错误日志：<code>sudo tail -n 200 /var/opt/mssql/log/errorlog</code></li>
<li>Linux 日志中的错误关键字：<code>sudo grep -iE 'error|fail|corrupt' /var/opt/mssql/log/errorlog | tail -100</code></li>
<li>Linux 内核 OOM 记录：<code>sudo dmesg -T | grep -iE 'oom|killed process'</code></li>
<li>扩展事件会话列表：<code>SELECT s.name, s.start_time, t.target_name, CAST(t.target_data AS xml) AS target_data FROM sys.dm_xe_sessions s JOIN sys.dm_xe_session_targets t ON s.address = t.event_session_address;</code></li>
<li>扩展事件目标：<code>SELECT s.name, t.target_name, t.file_name FROM sys.dm_xe_sessions s JOIN sys.dm_xe_session_targets t ON s.address = t.event_session_address;</code></li>
<li>system_health 会话状态：<code>SELECT name, create_time FROM sys.dm_xe_sessions WHERE name = N'system_health';</code></li>
<li>system_health 环形缓冲区：<code>SELECT CAST(t.target_data AS xml) AS target_data FROM sys.dm_xe_session_targets t JOIN sys.dm_xe_sessions s ON t.event_session_address = s.address WHERE s.name = N'system_health' AND t.target_name = N'ring_buffer';</code></li>
<li>连接环形缓冲区：<code>SELECT CAST(record AS xml) AS rb FROM sys.dm_os_ring_buffers WHERE ring_buffer_type = N'RING_BUFFER_CONNECTIVITY';</code></li>
<li>调度器监视环形缓冲区：<code>SELECT CAST(record AS xml) AS rb FROM sys.dm_os_ring_buffers WHERE ring_buffer_type = N'RING_BUFFER_SCHEDULER_MONITOR';</code></li>
<li>资源监视环形缓冲区：<code>SELECT CAST(record AS xml) AS rb FROM sys.dm_os_ring_buffers WHERE ring_buffer_type = N'RING_BUFFER_RESOURCE_MONITOR';</code></li>
<li>内存不足环形缓冲区：<code>SELECT CAST(record AS xml) AS rb FROM sys.dm_os_ring_buffers WHERE ring_buffer_type = N'RING_BUFFER_OOM';</code></li>
<li>可疑页明细：<code>SELECT database_id, file_id, page_id, event_type, error_count, last_update_date FROM msdb.dbo.suspect_pages ORDER BY last_update_date DESC;</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="六cpu--内存--io-性能181235">六、CPU / 内存 / IO 性能（181–235）</h2>
<ol start="181">
<li>实例 CPU 使用率：<code>SELECT TOP 5 record.value('(./Record/@id)[1]','int') AS record_id, 100 - record.value('(./Record/SchedulerMonitorEvent/SystemHealth/SystemIdle)[1]','int') AS cpu_usage_pct FROM (SELECT CONVERT(xml, record) AS record FROM sys.dm_os_ring_buffers WHERE ring_buffer_type = N'RING_BUFFER_SCHEDULER_MONITOR' AND record LIKE N'%&lt;SystemHealth&gt;%') AS x ORDER BY record_id DESC;</code></li>
<li>调度器负载：<code>SELECT scheduler_id, current_tasks_count, runnable_tasks_count, work_queue_count, pending_disk_io_count FROM sys.dm_os_schedulers WHERE status = N'VISIBLE ONLINE';</code></li>
<li>工作队列积压：<code>SELECT scheduler_id, work_queue_count FROM sys.dm_os_schedulers WHERE work_queue_count &gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>CPU 压力相关等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD', N'CXPACKET', N'CXCONSUMER', N'THREADPOOL');</code></li>
<li>存在可运行任务的调度器数：<code>SELECT COUNT(*) AS schedulers_with_runnable FROM sys.dm_os_schedulers WHERE runnable_tasks_count &gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>CPU 消耗最高 SQL：<code>SELECT TOP 20 qs.total_worker_time/1000 AS total_cpu_ms, qs.execution_count, qs.total_worker_time/qs.execution_count/1000 AS avg_cpu_ms, qs.total_elapsed_time/1000 AS total_elapsed_ms, SUBSTRING(st.text, (qs.statement_start_offset/2)+1, ((CASE qs.statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text) ELSE qs.statement_end_offset END - qs.statement_start_offset)/2)+1) AS sql_text, qp.query_plan FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) st CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_query_plan(qs.plan_handle) qp ORDER BY qs.total_worker_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>CPU 消耗最高存储过程：<code>SELECT TOP 20 OBJECT_NAME(ps.object_id) AS proc_name, ps.execution_count, ps.total_worker_time/1000 AS total_cpu_ms, ps.total_elapsed_time/1000 AS total_elapsed_ms FROM sys.dm_exec_procedure_stats ps ORDER BY ps.total_worker_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>CPU 消耗最高触发器：<code>SELECT TOP 20 OBJECT_NAME(ts.object_id) AS trigger_name, ts.execution_count, ts.total_worker_time/1000 AS total_cpu_ms FROM sys.dm_exec_trigger_stats ts ORDER BY ts.total_worker_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>编译与重编译次数：<code>SELECT counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name IN (N'SQL Compilations/sec', N'SQL Re-Compilations/sec') AND object_name LIKE N'%SQL Statistics%';</code></li>
<li>计划缓存总大小：<code>SELECT SUM(size_in_bytes)/1024/1024 AS plan_cache_mb FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans;</code></li>
<li>计划缓存命中率：<code>SELECT counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name IN (N'Cache Hit Ratio', N'Cache Hit Ratio Base') AND object_name LIKE N'%Plan Cache%';</code></li>
<li>单次使用计划数：<code>SELECT COUNT(*) AS single_use_plans FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans WHERE usecounts = 1;</code></li>
<li>计划缓存占用 Top：<code>SELECT TOP 20 objtype, COUNT(*) AS plans, SUM(size_in_bytes)/1024/1024 AS mb, SUM(usecounts) AS total_uses FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans GROUP BY objtype ORDER BY mb DESC;</code></li>
<li>内存 Clerk 占用：<code>SELECT TOP 20 type, SUM(pages_kb)/1024 AS mb FROM sys.dm_os_memory_clerks GROUP BY type ORDER BY mb DESC;</code></li>
<li>缓冲池大小：<code>SELECT COUNT(*)*8/1024 AS buffer_pool_mb FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors;</code></li>
<li>页生命周期：<code>SELECT object_name, counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name = N'Page life expectancy' AND object_name LIKE N'%Buffer Manager%';</code></li>
<li>内存授予等待：<code>SELECT session_id, wait_type, wait_time, wait_resource FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE wait_type LIKE N'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE%';</code></li>
<li>内存授予 Top：<code>SELECT TOP 20 session_id, requested_memory_kb/1024 AS requested_mb, granted_memory_kb/1024 AS granted_mb, max_used_memory_kb/1024 AS max_used_mb, dop, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_exec_query_memory_grants ORDER BY granted_memory_kb DESC;</code></li>
<li>目标内存与提交内存：<code>SELECT committed_kb/1024 AS committed_mb, committed_target_kb/1024 AS target_mb, committed_kb - committed_target_kb AS diff_mb FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;</code></li>
<li>系统可用物理内存：<code>SELECT total_physical_memory_kb/1024 AS total_mb, available_physical_memory_kb/1024 AS available_mb, system_memory_state_desc FROM sys.dm_os_sys_memory;</code></li>
<li>系统内存状态：<code>SELECT system_memory_state_desc FROM sys.dm_os_sys_memory;</code></li>
<li>缓冲池扩展：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_pool_extension_configuration;</code></li>
<li>内存优化表内存：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, memory_used_by_table_kb/1024 AS table_mb, memory_used_by_indexes_kb/1024 AS index_mb FROM sys.dm_db_xtp_table_memory_stats ORDER BY memory_used_by_table_kb DESC;</code></li>
<li>列存储行组状态（2016+）：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, state_desc, total_rows, deleted_rows FROM sys.dm_db_column_store_row_group_physical_stats;</code></li>
<li>锁内存占用：<code>SELECT SUM(pages_kb)/1024 AS lock_mb FROM sys.dm_os_memory_clerks WHERE type = N'LOCK_MANAGER';</code></li>
<li>连接内存占用：<code>SELECT SUM(pages_kb)/1024 AS connection_mb FROM sys.dm_os_memory_clerks WHERE type LIKE N'%CONNECTION%';</code></li>
<li>每库缓存页：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, COUNT(*)*8/1024 AS cached_mb FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors GROUP BY database_id ORDER BY cached_mb DESC;</code></li>
<li>脏页总数：<code>SELECT COUNT(*) AS dirty_pages FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors WHERE is_modified = 1;</code></li>
<li>检查点写入页：<code>SELECT counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name IN (N'Checkpoint pages/sec', N'Page writes/sec') AND object_name LIKE N'%Buffer Manager%';</code></li>
<li>惰性写入：<code>SELECT counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name = N'Lazy writes/sec' AND object_name LIKE N'%Buffer Manager%';</code></li>
<li>文件 IO 延迟明细：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(vfs.database_id) AS dbname, mf.physical_name, vfs.io_stall_read_ms, vfs.io_stall_write_ms, vfs.num_of_reads, vfs.num_of_writes FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) vfs JOIN sys.master_files mf ON vfs.database_id = mf.database_id AND vfs.file_id = mf.file_id;</code></li>
<li>数据库 IO 延迟汇总：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, SUM(io_stall_read_ms) AS read_stall_ms, SUM(io_stall_write_ms) AS write_stall_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) GROUP BY database_id ORDER BY read_stall_ms + write_stall_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>数据库 IO 吞吐：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, SUM(num_of_bytes_read)/1048576 AS read_mb, SUM(num_of_bytes_written)/1048576 AS write_mb FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) GROUP BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>读等待排名：<code>SELECT TOP 10 DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, file_id, io_stall_read_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) ORDER BY io_stall_read_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>写等待排名：<code>SELECT TOP 10 DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, file_id, io_stall_write_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) ORDER BY io_stall_write_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>待处理 IO：<code>SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_io FROM sys.dm_io_pending_io_requests;</code></li>
<li>IO 总 stall：<code>SELECT TOP 10 DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, file_id, io_stall FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) ORDER BY io_stall DESC;</code></li>
<li>读延迟超过 20ms 的文件：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, file_id, io_stall_read_ms/NULLIF(num_of_reads,0) AS avg_read_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) WHERE num_of_reads &gt; 0 AND io_stall_read_ms/NULLIF(num_of_reads,0) &gt; 20;</code></li>
<li>写延迟超过 20ms 的文件：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, file_id, io_stall_write_ms/NULLIF(num_of_writes,0) AS avg_write_ms FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) WHERE num_of_writes &gt; 0 AND io_stall_write_ms/NULLIF(num_of_writes,0) &gt; 20;</code></li>
<li>每库 IO stall 占比：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, SUM(io_stall) AS stall_ms, CAST(100.0*SUM(io_stall)/SUM(SUM(io_stall)) OVER() AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL,NULL) GROUP BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>缓冲页占比：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, COUNT(*) AS pages, CAST(100.0*COUNT(*)/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors GROUP BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>NUMA 节点：<code>SELECT node_id, node_state_desc, memory_node_id, processor_group, online_scheduler_count, active_worker_count FROM sys.dm_os_nodes;</code></li>
<li>CPU 亲和性：<code>SELECT parent_node_id, scheduler_id, cpu_id, is_online, is_idle FROM sys.dm_os_schedulers WHERE status = N'VISIBLE ONLINE';</code></li>
<li>软 NUMA：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'soft-numa';</code></li>
<li>处理器信息：<code>SELECT cpu_count, hyperthread_ratio, scheduler_count, numa_node_count FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;</code></li>
<li>SQL Server 工作集：<code>SELECT physical_memory_in_use_kb/1024 AS working_set_mb FROM sys.dm_os_process_memory;</code></li>
<li>虚拟地址空间：<code>SELECT virtual_address_space_reserved_kb/1024 AS reserved_mb, virtual_address_space_committed_kb/1024 AS committed_mb, virtual_address_space_available_kb/1024 AS available_mb FROM sys.dm_os_process_memory;</code></li>
<li>内存转储配置：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name IN (N'max dump count', N'min memory per query (KB)');</code></li>
<li>最大服务器内存建议值：<code>SELECT physical_memory_kb/1024 AS physical_mb, CAST(physical_memory_kb/1024*0.8 AS int) AS suggested_max_memory_mb FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;</code></li>
<li>缓冲缓存命中率：<code>SELECT counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name IN (N'Buffer cache hit ratio', N'Buffer cache hit ratio base') AND object_name LIKE N'%Buffer Manager%';</code></li>
<li>页生命周期当前值：<code>SELECT cntr_value AS page_life_expectancy FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name = N'Page life expectancy' AND object_name LIKE N'%Buffer Manager%';</code></li>
<li>内存授予超时：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE', N'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE_QUERY_COMPILE');</code></li>
<li>资源信号量：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE N'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE%';</code></li>
<li>内存压力等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'RESOURCE_MEMPHYSICAL_LOW', N'RESOURCE_MEMVIRTUAL_LOW', N'CMEMTHREAD');</code></li>
<li>单次使用计划占比：<code>SELECT CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN usecounts = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(5,2)) AS single_use_pct FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans;</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="七等待事件阻塞与死锁236275">七、等待事件、阻塞与死锁（236–275）</h2>
<ol start="236">
<li>等待统计 Top20：<code>SELECT TOP 20 wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms, max_wait_time_ms, CAST(100.0*wait_time_ms/SUM(wait_time_ms) OVER() AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>排除良性等待后的 Top：<code>SELECT TOP 20 wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type NOT IN (N'CLR_SEMAPHORE', N'LAZYWRITER_SLEEP', N'RESOURCE_QUEUE', N'SLEEP_TASK', N'SLEEP_SYSTEMTASK', N'SQLTRACE_BUFFER_FLUSH', N'WAITFOR', N'LOGMGR_QUEUE', N'CHECKPOINT_QUEUE', N'REQUEST_FOR_DEADLOCK_SEARCH', N'XE_TIMER_EVENT', N'BROKER_TO_FLUSH', N'BROKER_TASK_STOP', N'CLR_MANUAL_EVENT', N'CLR_AUTO_EVENT', N'DISPATCHER_QUEUE_SEMAPHORE', N'FT_IFTS_SCHEDULER_IDLE_WAIT', N'XE_DISPATCHER_WAIT', N'XE_DISPATCHER_JOIN', N'SQLTRACE_INCREMENTAL_FLUSH_SLEEP') ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>当前等待任务：<code>SELECT session_id, wait_type, wait_duration_ms, blocking_session_id, resource_description FROM sys.dm_os_waiting_tasks WHERE session_id &gt; 50 ORDER BY wait_duration_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>当前阻塞链：<code>SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_type, r.wait_time, r.wait_resource, r.status, r.command, DB_NAME(r.database_id) AS dbname FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r WHERE r.blocking_session_id &lt;&gt; 0 ORDER BY r.wait_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>头阻塞会话：<code>SELECT blocking_session_id, COUNT(*) AS blocked_count, MAX(wait_time) AS max_wait_ms FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id &lt;&gt; 0 GROUP BY blocking_session_id ORDER BY blocked_count DESC;</code></li>
<li>阻塞源 SQL：<code>SELECT s.session_id, s.login_name, s.host_name, s.program_name, t.text AS sql_text FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON r.blocking_session_id = s.session_id WHERE r.blocking_session_id &lt;&gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>被阻塞 SQL：<code>SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_time, SUBSTRING(t.text, (r.statement_start_offset/2)+1, ((CASE r.statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(t.text) ELSE r.statement_end_offset END - r.statement_start_offset)/2)+1) AS current_stmt FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t WHERE r.blocking_session_id &lt;&gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>当前锁列表：<code>SELECT request_session_id, resource_type, resource_database_id, resource_description, request_mode, request_status FROM sys.dm_tran_locks WHERE request_status = N'WAIT';</code></li>
<li>锁等待：<code>SELECT request_session_id, resource_type, request_mode, request_status FROM sys.dm_tran_locks WHERE request_status IN (N'WAIT', N'CONVERT');</code></li>
<li>锁升级：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE N'LCK_M_%';</code></li>
<li>意向锁冲突：<code>SELECT request_session_id, resource_type, request_mode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sys.dm_tran_locks GROUP BY request_session_id, resource_type, request_mode HAVING COUNT(*) &gt; 100;</code></li>
<li>死锁计数：<code>SELECT counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name = N'Number of Deadlocks/sec' AND object_name LIKE N'%Locks%';</code></li>
<li>死锁图（system_health）：<code>SELECT xdr.value('@timestamp','datetime') AS ts, xdr.query('.').value('(event/data[@name="xml_report"]/value/deadlock)[1]','nvarchar(max)') AS deadlock_graph FROM (SELECT CAST(target_data AS xml) AS td FROM sys.dm_xe_session_targets t JOIN sys.dm_xe_sessions s ON t.event_session_address = s.address WHERE s.name = N'system_health' AND t.target_name = N'ring_buffer') AS x CROSS APPLY td.nodes('//RingBufferTarget/event[@name="xml_deadlock_report"]') AS X(xdr);</code></li>
<li>死锁受害者与资源：<code>SELECT request_session_id, resource_type, request_mode, request_status FROM sys.dm_tran_locks WHERE request_status = N'WAIT';</code></li>
<li>活动事务：<code>SELECT transaction_id, name, transaction_begin_time, transaction_type, transaction_state FROM sys.dm_tran_active_transactions ORDER BY transaction_begin_time;</code></li>
<li>长事务：<code>SELECT transaction_id, name, transaction_begin_time, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, transaction_begin_time, GETDATE()) AS minutes FROM sys.dm_tran_active_transactions WHERE DATEDIFF(MINUTE, transaction_begin_time, GETDATE()) &gt; 30;</code></li>
<li>最老活动事务：<code>SELECT TOP 1 transaction_id, name, transaction_begin_time FROM sys.dm_tran_active_transactions ORDER BY transaction_begin_time;</code></li>
<li>当前库打开事务：<code>DBCC OPENTRAN WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>会话事务：<code>SELECT session_id, transaction_id, is_local, is_enlisted FROM sys.dm_tran_session_transactions;</code></li>
<li>数据库事务：<code>SELECT database_transaction_id, transaction_id, database_id, database_transaction_begin_time, database_transaction_state FROM sys.dm_tran_database_transactions;</code></li>
<li>事务日志使用：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, database_transaction_log_bytes_used/1048576 AS log_used_mb FROM sys.dm_tran_database_transactions GROUP BY database_id;</code></li>
<li>版本存储：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, reserved_space_kb/1024 AS reserved_mb FROM sys.dm_tran_version_store_space_usage;</code></li>
<li>快照隔离冲突：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'ROWGROUP_UPDATE', N'VERSION_RECORD');</code></li>
<li>行版本等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE N'%VERSION%';</code></li>
<li>锁等待类型：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE N'LCK_M_%' ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>页 IO 闩锁等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE N'PAGEIOLATCH_%' ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>并行等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'CXPACKET', N'CXCONSUMER');</code></li>
<li>调度器让出等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = N'SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD';</code></li>
<li>内存信号量等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE N'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE%';</code></li>
<li>异步 IO 等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'ASYNC_IO_COMPLETION', N'IO_COMPLETION');</code></li>
<li>日志写入等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = N'WRITELOG';</code></li>
<li>AlwaysOn 同步提交等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = N'HADR_SYNC_COMMIT';</code></li>
<li>线程池等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = N'THREADPOOL';</code></li>
<li>内存分配等待：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'MEMORY_ALLOCATION_EXT', N'CMEMTHREAD');</code></li>
<li>等待类别汇总：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_time_ms &gt; 0 ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>闩锁统计：<code>SELECT TOP 20 latch_class, waiting_requests_count, wait_time_ms, max_wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_latch_stats ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>自旋锁统计：<code>SELECT TOP 20 name, collisions, spins, spins_per_collision FROM sys.dm_os_spinlock_stats ORDER BY spins DESC;</code></li>
<li>锁超时错误：<code>SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type IN (N'LCK_M_S', N'LCK_M_X', N'LCK_M_U');</code></li>
<li>阻塞进程报告配置：<code>SELECT name, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = N'blocked process threshold (s)';</code></li>
<li>会话死锁优先级：<code>SELECT session_id, deadlock_priority FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
</ol>

<h2 id="八会话连接与请求276305">八、会话、连接与请求（276–305）</h2>
<ol start="276">
<li>会话总览：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, host_name, program_name, status, login_time FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
<li>活动请求：<code>SELECT session_id, status, command, wait_type, wait_time, cpu_time, total_elapsed_time, reads, writes FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE session_id &gt; 50;</code></li>
<li>长时间运行请求：<code>SELECT session_id, status, command, total_elapsed_time/1000 AS elapsed_sec, cpu_time, wait_type FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE total_elapsed_time &gt; 60000 ORDER BY total_elapsed_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>按登录名统计会话：<code>SELECT login_name, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 GROUP BY login_name ORDER BY sessions DESC;</code></li>
<li>按程序名统计会话：<code>SELECT program_name, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 GROUP BY program_name ORDER BY sessions DESC;</code></li>
<li>按主机名统计会话：<code>SELECT host_name, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 GROUP BY host_name ORDER BY sessions DESC;</code></li>
<li>连接数统计：<code>SELECT net_transport, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM sys.dm_exec_connections GROUP BY net_transport;</code></li>
<li>客户端 IP 分布：<code>SELECT client_net_address, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM sys.dm_exec_connections GROUP BY client_net_address ORDER BY connections DESC;</code></li>
<li>加密连接：<code>SELECT encrypt_option, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM sys.dm_exec_connections GROUP BY encrypt_option;</code></li>
<li>认证方式：<code>SELECT auth_scheme, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM sys.dm_exec_connections GROUP BY auth_scheme;</code></li>
<li>会话内存使用：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, memory_usage*8/1024 AS memory_mb FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 ORDER BY memory_usage DESC;</code></li>
<li>会话 CPU 使用：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, cpu_time, total_elapsed_time FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 ORDER BY cpu_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>会话读写量：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, reads, writes, logical_reads FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 ORDER BY logical_reads DESC;</code></li>
<li>请求等待明细：<code>SELECT session_id, wait_type, wait_time, wait_resource, blocking_session_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE wait_type IS NOT NULL;</code></li>
<li>请求执行进度：<code>SELECT session_id, command, percent_complete, estimated_completion_time/1000 AS eta_sec FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE percent_complete &gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>并行度：<code>SELECT session_id, dop, command FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE dop &gt; 1;</code></li>
<li>授予内存：<code>SELECT session_id, granted_memory_kb/1024 AS granted_mb, requested_memory_kb/1024 AS requested_mb FROM sys.dm_exec_query_memory_grants;</code></li>
<li>会话打开事务数：<code>SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS open_transactions FROM sys.dm_tran_session_transactions GROUP BY session_id;</code></li>
<li>会话隔离级别：<code>SELECT session_id, transaction_isolation_level FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
<li>会话锁超时：<code>SELECT session_id, lock_timeout FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
<li>会话死锁优先级：<code>SELECT session_id, deadlock_priority FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
<li>会话状态：<code>SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 GROUP BY status;</code></li>
<li>空闲会话：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, status, last_request_end_time FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE status = N'sleeping' AND is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
<li>睡眠会话时长：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, last_request_end_time, GETDATE()) AS idle_minutes FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE status = N'sleeping' AND is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
<li>会话登录时间：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, login_time, DATEDIFF(HOUR, login_time, GETDATE()) AS hours_connected FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 ORDER BY login_time;</code></li>
<li>会话最后请求时间：<code>SELECT session_id, login_name, last_request_start_time, last_request_end_time FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1;</code></li>
<li>连接传输类型：<code>SELECT net_transport, protocol_type, protocol_version, num_reads, num_writes FROM sys.dm_exec_connections;</code></li>
<li>异常程序名：<code>SELECT program_name, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 AND program_name IS NULL GROUP BY program_name;</code></li>
<li>每数据库会话数：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE database_id &gt; 0 GROUP BY database_id ORDER BY sessions DESC;</code></li>
<li>会话按状态与登录汇总：<code>SELECT login_name, status, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 GROUP BY login_name, status ORDER BY sessions DESC;</code></li>
</ol>

<h2 id="九索引统计信息与碎片306345">九、索引、统计信息与碎片（306–345）</h2>
<ol start="306">
<li>碎片率超过 30% 的索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(ips.object_id)+'.'+OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, ips.index_type_desc, ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent, ips.page_count FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'SAMPLED') ips JOIN sys.indexes i ON ips.object_id = i.object_id AND ips.index_id = i.index_id WHERE ips.page_count &gt; 1000 AND ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent &gt; 30 ORDER BY ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC;</code></li>
<li>碎片率 10%–30% 的索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(ips.object_id)+'.'+OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent, ips.page_count FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'SAMPLED') ips JOIN sys.indexes i ON ips.object_id = i.object_id AND ips.index_id = i.index_id WHERE ips.page_count &gt; 1000 AND ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent BETWEEN 10 AND 30 ORDER BY ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC;</code></li>
<li>页密度低于 70% 的索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, ips.avg_page_space_used_in_percent FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'SAMPLED') ips JOIN sys.indexes i ON ips.object_id = i.object_id AND ips.index_id = i.index_id WHERE ips.avg_page_space_used_in_percent &lt; 70;</code></li>
<li>从未使用的索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, ius.user_seeks, ius.user_scans, ius.user_lookups, ius.user_updates FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats ius ON i.object_id = ius.object_id AND i.index_id = ius.index_id AND ius.database_id = DB_ID() WHERE i.index_id &gt; 0 AND i.is_primary_key = 0 AND i.is_unique_constraint = 0 AND ISNULL(ius.user_seeks,0) + ISNULL(ius.user_scans,0) + ISNULL(ius.user_lookups,0) = 0;</code></li>
<li>索引查找与扫描次数：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, user_seeks, user_scans, user_lookups FROM sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats WHERE database_id = DB_ID() ORDER BY user_scans DESC;</code></li>
<li>索引更新次数：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, user_updates, user_seeks FROM sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats WHERE database_id = DB_ID() ORDER BY user_updates DESC;</code></li>
<li>缺失索引：<code>SELECT TOP 20 DB_NAME(mid.database_id) AS dbname, OBJECT_NAME(mid.object_id, mid.database_id) AS table_name, mid.equality_columns, mid.inequality_columns, mid.included_columns FROM sys.dm_db_missing_index_details mid JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_groups mig ON mid.index_handle = mig.index_handle JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_group_stats migs ON mig.index_group_handle = migs.group_handle ORDER BY migs.avg_total_user_cost * migs.avg_user_impact * (migs.user_seeks + migs.user_scans) DESC;</code></li>
<li>缺失索引开销：<code>SELECT TOP 20 migs.avg_total_user_cost * migs.avg_user_impact * (migs.user_seeks + migs.user_scans) AS score, migs.user_seeks, migs.user_scans, migs.avg_total_user_cost, migs.avg_user_impact FROM sys.dm_db_missing_index_groups mig JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_group_stats migs ON mig.index_group_handle = migs.group_handle ORDER BY score DESC;</code></li>
<li>重复索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(i1.object_id) AS table_name, i1.name AS index1, i2.name AS index2 FROM sys.indexes i1 JOIN sys.indexes i2 ON i1.object_id = i2.object_id AND i1.index_id &lt; i2.index_id AND i1.type = i2.type WHERE i1.is_primary_key = 0 AND i2.is_primary_key = 0 AND i1.key_columns = i2.key_columns;</code></li>
<li>重叠索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.type_desc, i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.object_id IN (SELECT object_id FROM sys.indexes WHERE type = 2 GROUP BY object_id HAVING COUNT(*) &gt; 5);</code></li>
<li>写多读少的索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, user_updates, user_seeks, user_scans FROM sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats WHERE database_id = DB_ID() AND user_updates &gt; user_seeks + user_scans ORDER BY user_updates DESC;</code></li>
<li>索引行锁等待：<code>SELECT TOP 20 OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, row_lock_count, row_lock_wait_count, row_lock_wait_in_ms FROM sys.dm_db_index_operational_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL) ORDER BY row_lock_wait_in_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>索引页闩锁等待：<code>SELECT TOP 20 OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, page_io_latch_wait_count, page_io_latch_wait_in_ms FROM sys.dm_db_index_operational_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL) ORDER BY page_io_latch_wait_in_ms DESC;</code></li>
<li>索引 IO 等待：<code>SELECT TOP 20 OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, range_scan_count, singleton_lookup_count FROM sys.dm_db_index_operational_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL) ORDER BY range_scan_count DESC;</code></li>
<li>统计信息更新时间：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(s.object_id) AS table_name, s.name AS stats_name, sp.last_updated, sp.rows, sp.rows_sampled, sp.modification_counter FROM sys.stats s CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(s.object_id, s.stats_id) sp WHERE OBJECTPROPERTY(s.object_id,'IsUserTable') = 1 ORDER BY sp.last_updated;</code></li>
<li>统计信息过期：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(s.object_id) AS table_name, s.name AS stats_name, sp.last_updated, sp.modification_counter, sp.rows FROM sys.stats s CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(s.object_id, s.stats_id) sp WHERE sp.modification_counter &gt; sp.rows * 0.2 ORDER BY sp.modification_counter DESC;</code></li>
<li>统计信息采样率：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(s.object_id) AS table_name, s.name AS stats_name, sp.rows, sp.rows_sampled, CAST(100.0*sp.rows_sampled/NULLIF(sp.rows,0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS sample_pct FROM sys.stats s CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(s.object_id, s.stats_id) sp;</code></li>
<li>统计信息直方图（2016 SP1 CU2+）：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_db_stats_histogram(OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.YourTable'), 1);</code></li>
<li>自动创建统计信息：<code>SELECT name, is_auto_create_stats_on FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>自动更新统计信息：<code>SELECT name, is_auto_update_stats_on, is_auto_update_stats_async_on FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>统计信息行数与实际行数偏差：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(s.object_id) AS table_name, s.name AS stats_name, sp.rows AS stats_rows, p.rows AS actual_rows FROM sys.stats s CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(s.object_id, s.stats_id) sp JOIN sys.partitions p ON s.object_id = p.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE p.partition_number = 1;</code></li>
<li>索引压缩：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(p.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, p.partition_number, p.data_compression_desc FROM sys.partitions p JOIN sys.indexes i ON p.object_id = i.object_id AND p.index_id = i.index_id WHERE p.data_compression_desc &lt;&gt; N'NONE';</code></li>
<li>压缩收益评估：<code>EXEC sys.sp_estimate_data_compression_savings @schema_name = N'dbo', @object_name = N'YourTable', @index_id = NULL, @partition_number = NULL, @data_compression = N'PAGE';</code></li>
<li>分区索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.type_desc FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.partition_schemes ps ON i.data_space_id = ps.data_space_id;</code></li>
<li>分区边界：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(pf.object_id) AS function_name, pf.type_desc, pv.boundary_id, pv.value FROM sys.partition_functions pf JOIN sys.partition_range_values pv ON pf.function_id = pv.function_id ORDER BY pv.boundary_id;</code></li>
<li>索引填充因子：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, name AS index_name, fill_factor FROM sys.indexes WHERE fill_factor &lt;&gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>禁用索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, name AS index_name, type_desc FROM sys.indexes WHERE is_disabled = 1;</code></li>
<li>索引状态：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, name AS index_name, is_unique, is_primary_key, is_unique_constraint, is_padded, is_disabled FROM sys.indexes WHERE index_id &gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>索引键列：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(ic.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, ic.key_ordinal, c.name AS column_name, ic.is_descending_key FROM sys.index_columns ic JOIN sys.indexes i ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON ic.object_id = c.object_id AND ic.column_id = c.column_id WHERE ic.is_included_column = 0 ORDER BY ic.object_id, ic.index_id, ic.key_ordinal;</code></li>
<li>包含列：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(ic.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, c.name AS included_column FROM sys.index_columns ic JOIN sys.indexes i ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON ic.object_id = c.object_id AND ic.column_id = c.column_id WHERE ic.is_included_column = 1;</code></li>
<li>筛选索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, name AS index_name, filter_definition FROM sys.indexes WHERE has_filter = 1;</code></li>
<li>列存储索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, name AS index_name, type_desc FROM sys.indexes WHERE type IN (5,6);</code></li>
<li>全文索引：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, name, is_enabled, change_tracking_state_desc FROM sys.fulltext_indexes;</code></li>
<li>索引重建/变更记录：<code>DECLARE @p nvarchar(260); SELECT @p = CAST(value AS nvarchar(260)) FROM sys.fn_trace_getinfo(NULL) WHERE traceid = 1 AND property = 2; SELECT * FROM sys.fn_trace_gettable(@p, DEFAULT) WHERE EventClass = 164;</code></li>
<li>索引维护作业：<code>SELECT j.name, j.enabled FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j WHERE j.name LIKE N'%Index%' OR j.name LIKE N'%索引%';</code></li>
<li>堆碎片：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name, ips.page_count, ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'SAMPLED') ips JOIN sys.indexes i ON ips.object_id = i.object_id AND ips.index_id = i.index_id WHERE i.type = 0 AND ips.page_count &gt; 1000;</code></li>
<li>堆转发记录：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, forwarded_record_count FROM sys.dm_db_index_operational_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL) WHERE forwarded_record_count &gt; 0 ORDER BY forwarded_record_count DESC;</code></li>
<li>鬼影记录：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, index_id, ghost_record_count FROM sys.dm_db_index_operational_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL) WHERE ghost_record_count &gt; 0 ORDER BY ghost_record_count DESC;</code></li>
<li>表索引一致性检查：<code>DBCC CHECKTABLE(N'dbo.YourTable') WITH NO_INFOMSGS, ALL_ERRORMSGS;</code></li>
<li>索引物理统计明细：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.YourTable'), NULL, NULL, 'DETAILED');</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="十备份与恢复346405">十、备份与恢复（346–405）</h2>
<ol start="346">
<li>全备历史：<code>SELECT bs.database_name, bs.backup_start_date, bs.backup_finish_date, bs.backup_size/1048576 AS size_mb, bmf.physical_device_name FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupmediafamily bmf ON bs.media_set_id = bmf.media_set_id WHERE bs.type = 'D' AND bs.backup_finish_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()) ORDER BY bs.backup_finish_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>差异备份历史：<code>SELECT bs.database_name, bs.backup_start_date, bs.backup_finish_date, bs.backup_size/1048576 AS size_mb FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs WHERE bs.type = 'I' AND bs.backup_finish_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()) ORDER BY bs.backup_finish_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>日志备份历史：<code>SELECT bs.database_name, bs.backup_start_date, bs.backup_finish_date, bs.backup_size/1048576 AS size_mb FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs WHERE bs.type = 'L' AND bs.backup_finish_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()) ORDER BY bs.backup_finish_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>每库最后全备：<code>SELECT d.name, MAX(bs.backup_finish_date) AS last_full FROM sys.databases d LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs ON d.name = bs.database_name AND bs.type = 'D' GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY last_full;</code></li>
<li>每库最后差异备份：<code>SELECT d.name, MAX(bs.backup_finish_date) AS last_diff FROM sys.databases d LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs ON d.name = bs.database_name AND bs.type = 'I' GROUP BY d.name;</code></li>
<li>每库最后日志备份：<code>SELECT d.name, MAX(bs.backup_finish_date) AS last_log FROM sys.databases d LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs ON d.name = bs.database_name AND bs.type = 'L' GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY last_log;</code></li>
<li>备份失败记录：<code>SELECT bs.database_name, bs.backup_start_date, bs.backup_finish_date, bs.is_damaged FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs WHERE bs.is_damaged = 1 ORDER BY bs.backup_finish_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>备份大小趋势：<code>SELECT database_name, CAST(backup_start_date AS date) AS backup_date, backup_size/1048576 AS size_mb FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE type = 'D' AND backup_start_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-30,GETDATE()) ORDER BY database_name, backup_start_date;</code></li>
<li>备份压缩率：<code>SELECT database_name, backup_start_date, backup_size/1048576 AS size_mb, compressed_backup_size/1048576 AS compressed_mb, CAST(100.0*(backup_size-compressed_backup_size)/NULLIF(backup_size,0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS compression_pct FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE type = 'D' AND backup_start_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE());</code></li>
<li>备份耗时：<code>SELECT database_name, backup_start_date, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, backup_start_date, backup_finish_date) AS duration_min FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE backup_start_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()) ORDER BY duration_min DESC;</code></li>
<li>备份设备：<code>SELECT name, physical_name, type_desc, is_default FROM sys.backup_devices;</code></li>
<li>备份物理路径：<code>SELECT bs.database_name, bs.backup_start_date, bmf.physical_device_name FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs JOIN msdb.dbo.backupmediafamily bmf ON bs.media_set_id = bmf.media_set_id WHERE bs.backup_start_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()) ORDER BY bs.backup_start_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>备份文件是否存在：<code>EXEC master.dbo.xp_fileexist N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak';</code></li>
<li>备份校验和：<code>SELECT database_name, backup_start_date, has_backup_checksums FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE backup_start_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE());</code></li>
<li>备份过期时间：<code>SELECT database_name, backup_start_date, expires_on FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE expires_on IS NOT NULL AND expires_on &lt; GETDATE();</code></li>
<li>备份加密：<code>SELECT database_name, backup_start_date, key_algorithm, encryptor_thumbprint FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE key_algorithm IS NOT NULL;</code></li>
<li>仅复制备份：<code>SELECT database_name, backup_start_date, is_copy_only FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE is_copy_only = 1;</code></li>
<li>备份链 LSN：<code>SELECT database_name, type, backup_start_date, first_lsn, last_lsn, checkpoint_lsn, database_backup_lsn, differential_base_lsn FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE database_name = N'YourDB' ORDER BY backup_start_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>备份介质集：<code>SELECT media_set_id, media_family_count, family_count, mirror_count FROM msdb.dbo.backupmediaset ORDER BY media_set_id DESC;</code></li>
<li>备份到 URL：<code>SELECT database_name, backup_start_date, bmf.physical_device_name FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs JOIN msdb.dbo.backupmediafamily bmf ON bs.media_set_id = bmf.media_set_id WHERE bmf.physical_device_name LIKE N'https://%';</code></li>
<li>备份作业状态：<code>SELECT j.name, j.enabled, h.run_status, h.run_date, h.run_time FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h ON j.job_id = h.job_id WHERE j.name LIKE N'%Backup%' OR j.name LIKE N'%备份%';</code></li>
<li>备份作业历史：<code>SELECT j.name, h.step_name, h.run_status, h.run_date, h.run_time, h.message FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON h.job_id = j.job_id WHERE j.name LIKE N'%Backup%' ORDER BY h.run_date DESC, h.run_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>恢复历史：<code>SELECT restore_date, destination_database_name, user_name, backup_set_id, restore_type FROM msdb.dbo.restorehistory ORDER BY restore_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>恢复失败：<code>SELECT restore_date, destination_database_name, restore_type FROM msdb.dbo.restorehistory WHERE restore_type = 'D' AND restore_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()) ORDER BY restore_date DESC;</code></li>
<li>恢复耗时：<code>SELECT rh.destination_database_name, rh.restore_date, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, bs.backup_finish_date, rh.restore_date) AS restore_min FROM msdb.dbo.restorehistory rh JOIN msdb.dbo.backupset bs ON rh.backup_set_id = bs.backup_set_id WHERE rh.restore_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE());</code></li>
<li>备份验证：<code>RESTORE VERIFYONLY FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH CHECKSUM;</code></li>
<li>备份头信息：<code>RESTORE HEADERONLY FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak';</code></li>
<li>备份文件列表：<code>RESTORE FILELISTONLY FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak';</code></li>
<li>备份介质标签：<code>RESTORE LABELONLY FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak';</code></li>
<li>数据库完整性检查：<code>DBCC CHECKDB(N'YourDB') WITH NO_INFOMSGS, ALL_ERRORMSGS;</code></li>
<li>物理一致性检查：<code>DBCC CHECKDB(N'YourDB') WITH PHYSICAL_ONLY, NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>表一致性检查：<code>DBCC CHECKTABLE(N'dbo.YourTable') WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>文件组一致性检查：<code>DBCC CHECKFILEGROUP WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>分配一致性检查：<code>DBCC CHECKALLOC(N'YourDB') WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>系统目录一致性检查：<code>DBCC CHECKCATALOG(N'YourDB') WITH NO_INFOMSGS;</code></li>
<li>可疑页：<code>SELECT database_id, file_id, page_id, event_type, error_count FROM msdb.dbo.suspect_pages;</code></li>
<li>页自动修复：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_hadr_auto_page_repair;</code></li>
<li>页还原：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB PAGE = N'1:1234' FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH NORECOVERY;</code></li>
<li>尾日志备份：<code>BACKUP LOG YourDB TO DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_TAIL.trn' WITH NORECOVERY, NO_TRUNCATE;</code></li>
<li>日志链断裂检查：<code>SELECT database_name, type, backup_start_date, first_lsn, last_lsn FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE database_name = N'YourDB' ORDER BY backup_start_date;</code></li>
<li>恢复模式切换：<code>ALTER DATABASE YourDB SET RECOVERY FULL;</code></li>
<li>简单模式日志截断：<code>SELECT name, log_reuse_wait_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE recovery_model_desc = N'SIMPLE';</code></li>
<li>日志备份频率检查：<code>SELECT database_name, COUNT(*) AS log_backups, MIN(backup_finish_date) AS first_backup, MAX(backup_finish_date) AS last_backup FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE type = 'L' AND backup_finish_date &gt;= DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE()) GROUP BY database_name;</code></li>
<li>日志空间不足：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, used_log_space_in_percent FROM sys.dm_db_log_space_usage WHERE used_log_space_in_percent &gt; 80;</code></li>
<li>日志增长：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, name, size*8/1024 AS size_mb FROM sys.master_files WHERE type_desc = N'LOG' ORDER BY size_mb DESC;</code></li>
<li>日志收缩：<code>DBCC SHRINKFILE (N'YourDB_log', 1024);</code></li>
<li>数据文件收缩：<code>DBCC SHRINKFILE (N'YourDB_Data', 10240);</code></li>
<li>自动增长事件：<code>DECLARE @p nvarchar(260); SELECT @p = CAST(value AS nvarchar(260)) FROM sys.fn_trace_getinfo(NULL) WHERE traceid = 1 AND property = 2; SELECT * FROM sys.fn_trace_gettable(@p, DEFAULT) WHERE EventClass IN (92,93);</code></li>
<li>数据库快照回滚：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB FROM DATABASE_SNAPSHOT = N'YourDB_Snap';</code></li>
<li>时间点恢复：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH NORECOVERY; RESTORE LOG YourDB FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_LOG.trn' WITH STOPAT = N'2026-11-06T10:00:00', RECOVERY;</code></li>
<li>STANDBY 只读还原：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH STANDBY = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_STANDBY.bak';</code></li>
<li>文件组还原：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB FILEGROUP = N'PRIMARY' FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH NORECOVERY;</code></li>
<li>页面还原：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB PAGE = N'1:1234' FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH NORECOVERY;</code></li>
<li>部分还原：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB FILEGROUP = N'PRIMARY' FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH PARTIAL, NORECOVERY;</code></li>
<li>在线还原：<code>RESTORE DATABASE YourDB FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH ONLINE, NORECOVERY;</code></li>
<li>加速数据库恢复（2019+）：<code>ALTER DATABASE YourDB SET ACCELERATED_DATABASE_RECOVERY = ON;</code></li>
<li>备份压缩配置：<code>EXEC sys.sp_configure N'backup compression default', 1; RECONFIGURE;</code></li>
<li>备份限速：<code>BACKUP DATABASE YourDB TO DISK = N'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' WITH MAXTRANSFERSIZE = 4194304, BUFFERCOUNT = 50;</code></li>
<li>镜像备份：<code>BACKUP DATABASE YourDB TO DISK = N'D:\Backup\A.bak' MIRROR TO DISK = N'E:\Backup\B.bak' WITH FORMAT, INIT;</code></li>
<li>备份校验配置：<code>EXEC sys.sp_configure N'backup checksum default', 1; RECONFIGURE;</code></li>
</ol>

<h2 id="十一高可用与复制406435">十一、高可用与复制（406–435）</h2>
<ol start="406">
<li>可用性组列表：<code>SELECT name, cluster_type_desc, automated_backup_preference_desc FROM sys.availability_groups;</code></li>
<li>AG 副本状态：<code>SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, ar.replica_server_name, ars.role_desc, ars.operational_state_desc, ars.connected_state_desc, ars.synchronization_health_desc FROM sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_states ars JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON ars.replica_id = ar.replica_id JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON ars.group_id = ag.group_id;</code></li>
<li>AG 数据库状态：<code>SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, adc.database_name, drs.synchronization_state_desc, drs.database_state_desc, drs.is_suspended, drs.suspend_reason_desc FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs JOIN sys.availability_databases_cluster adc ON drs.database_id = adc.database_id AND drs.group_id = adc.group_id JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id;</code></li>
<li>AG 同步延迟：<code>SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, adc.database_name, drs.secondary_lag_seconds FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs JOIN sys.availability_databases_cluster adc ON drs.database_id = adc.database_id AND drs.group_id = adc.group_id JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id WHERE drs.is_local = 0;</code></li>
<li>AG 发送队列：<code>SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, adc.database_name, drs.log_send_queue_size, drs.log_send_rate FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs JOIN sys.availability_databases_cluster adc ON drs.database_id = adc.database_id AND drs.group_id = adc.group_id JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id;</code></li>
<li>AG 重做队列：<code>SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, adc.database_name, drs.redo_queue_size, drs.redo_rate FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs JOIN sys.availability_databases_cluster adc ON drs.database_id = adc.database_id AND drs.group_id = adc.group_id JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON drs.group_id = ag.group_id;</code></li>
<li>AG 健康状态：<code>SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, ag.primary_recovery_health_desc, ag.secondary_recovery_health_desc FROM sys.availability_groups ag;</code></li>
<li>AG 故障转移模式：<code>SELECT ar.replica_server_name, ar.failover_mode_desc, ar.availability_mode_desc FROM sys.availability_replicas ar;</code></li>
<li>AG 可用性模式：<code>SELECT ar.replica_server_name, ar.availability_mode_desc, ar.session_timeout FROM sys.availability_replicas ar;</code></li>
<li>AG 自动页修复：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.dm_hadr_auto_page_repair;</code></li>
<li>集群节点：<code>SELECT member_name, member_type_desc, member_state_desc, number_of_quorum_votes FROM sys.dm_hadr_cluster_members;</code></li>
<li>集群仲裁：<code>SELECT cluster_name, quorum_type_desc, quorum_state_desc FROM sys.dm_hadr_cluster;</code></li>
<li>集群网络：<code>SELECT member_name, network_subnet_ip, is_public, state_desc FROM sys.dm_hadr_cluster_networks;</code></li>
<li>AG 监听器：<code>SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, l.dns_name, l.port, l.is_conformant FROM sys.availability_group_listeners l JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON l.group_id = ag.group_id;</code></li>
<li>AG 备份优先级：<code>SELECT ar.replica_server_name, ar.backup_priority, ar.seeding_mode_desc FROM sys.availability_replicas ar;</code></li>
<li>AG 只读路由：<code>SELECT ar.replica_server_name, ar.read_only_routing_url FROM sys.availability_replicas ar WHERE ar.read_only_routing_url IS NOT NULL;</code></li>
<li>AG 种子模式：<code>SELECT ar.replica_server_name, ar.seeding_mode_desc FROM sys.availability_replicas ar;</code></li>
<li>数据库镜像状态：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, mirroring_state_desc, mirroring_role_desc, mirroring_safety_level_desc FROM sys.database_mirroring WHERE mirroring_guid IS NOT NULL;</code></li>
<li>镜像连接：<code>SELECT connection_id, database_id, is_peer, state_desc FROM sys.dm_db_mirroring_connections;</code></li>
<li>日志传送主库：<code>SELECT primary_database, backup_directory, backup_retention_period, backup_threshold, threshold_alert_enabled FROM msdb.dbo.log_shipping_monitor_primary;</code></li>
<li>日志传送备库：<code>SELECT secondary_server, secondary_database, restore_delay, last_restored_file, last_restored_date FROM msdb.dbo.log_shipping_monitor_secondary;</code></li>
<li>日志传送延迟：<code>SELECT secondary_database, last_restored_date, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, last_restored_date, GETDATE()) AS delay_min FROM msdb.dbo.log_shipping_monitor_secondary;</code></li>
<li>日志传送历史：<code>SELECT * FROM msdb.dbo.log_shipping_monitor_history_detail ORDER BY log_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>日志传送告警：<code>SELECT * FROM msdb.dbo.log_shipping_monitor_alert;</code></li>
<li>复制发布：<code>SELECT name, publication_type, status, sync_method FROM distribution.dbo.MSpublications;</code></li>
<li>复制订阅：<code>SELECT s.name AS subscription, a.article, s.subscriber_db, s.status FROM distribution.dbo.MSsubscriptions s JOIN distribution.dbo.MSarticles a ON s.article_id = a.article_id;</code></li>
<li>复制延迟：<code>SELECT publisher_database_id, subscriber, latency, status FROM distribution.dbo.MSdistribution_status;</code></li>
<li>复制代理状态：<code>SELECT name, status, startup_time, last_execution_time FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs WHERE name LIKE N'%Replication%';</code></li>
<li>CDC 状态：<code>SELECT name, is_cdc_enabled FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>变更跟踪：<code>SELECT name, is_change_tracking_on FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
</ol>
