<h2 id="十二安全权限与审计436460">十二、安全、权限与审计（436–460）</h2>
<ol start="436">
<li>登录名列表：<code>SELECT name, type_desc, is_disabled, create_date, modify_date, default_database_name FROM sys.server_principals WHERE type IN ('S','U','G') ORDER BY name;</code></li>
<li>禁用登录名：<code>SELECT name, type_desc FROM sys.server_principals WHERE is_disabled = 1;</code></li>
<li>SQL 登录密码策略：<code>SELECT name, is_policy_checked, is_expiration_checked FROM sys.sql_logins;</code></li>
<li>密码过期登录：<code>SELECT name, LOGINPROPERTY(name,'DaysUntilExpiration') AS days_until_expiration FROM sys.sql_logins WHERE LOGINPROPERTY(name,'DaysUntilExpiration') IS NOT NULL;</code></li>
<li>sysadmin 成员：<code>SELECT p.name FROM sys.server_role_members rm JOIN sys.server_principals r ON rm.role_principal_id = r.principal_id JOIN sys.server_principals p ON rm.member_principal_id = p.principal_id WHERE r.name = N'sysadmin';</code></li>
<li>服务器角色成员：<code>SELECT r.name AS role_name, p.name AS member_name FROM sys.server_role_members rm JOIN sys.server_principals r ON rm.role_principal_id = r.principal_id JOIN sys.server_principals p ON rm.member_principal_id = p.principal_id ORDER BY r.name, p.name;</code></li>
<li>数据库角色成员：<code>SELECT r.name AS role_name, p.name AS member_name FROM sys.database_role_members rm JOIN sys.database_principals r ON rm.role_principal_id = r.principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals p ON rm.member_principal_id = p.principal_id;</code></li>
<li>服务器权限授予：<code>SELECT pr.name AS grantee, sp.permission_name, sp.state_desc FROM sys.server_permissions sp JOIN sys.server_principals pr ON sp.grantee_principal_id = pr.principal_id WHERE sp.state_desc = N'GRANT';</code></li>
<li>权限拒绝：<code>SELECT pr.name AS grantee, sp.permission_name, sp.state_desc FROM sys.server_permissions sp JOIN sys.server_principals pr ON sp.grantee_principal_id = pr.principal_id WHERE sp.state_desc = N'DENY';</code></li>
<li>孤儿用户：<code>EXEC sys.sp_MSforeachdb N'USE [?]; SELECT DB_NAME() AS dbname, dp.name AS orphan_user FROM sys.database_principals dp LEFT JOIN sys.server_principals sp ON dp.sid = sp.sid WHERE dp.type IN (''S'',''U'',''G'') AND dp.principal_id &gt; 4 AND sp.sid IS NULL;';</code></li>
<li>数据库所有者：<code>SELECT name, SUSER_SNAME(owner_sid) AS owner FROM sys.databases;</code></li>
<li>证书：<code>SELECT name, subject, expiry_date, pvt_key_encryption_type_desc FROM sys.certificates;</code></li>
<li>对称密钥：<code>SELECT name, algorithm_desc, key_length, create_date FROM sys.symmetric_keys;</code></li>
<li>非对称密钥：<code>SELECT name, algorithm_desc, key_length, create_date FROM sys.asymmetric_keys;</code></li>
<li>TDE 状态：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, encryption_state_desc, percent_complete, key_algorithm, key_length FROM sys.dm_database_encryption_keys;</code></li>
<li>加密密钥轮换：<code>SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS dbname, key_algorithm, key_length, encryptor_type FROM sys.dm_database_encryption_keys;</code></li>
<li>服务器审核：<code>SELECT name, type_desc, is_state_enabled, audit_file_path FROM sys.server_audits;</code></li>
<li>审核运行状态：<code>SELECT name, status_desc, status_time, audit_file_path FROM sys.dm_server_audit_status;</code></li>
<li>审核文件读取：<code>SELECT * FROM sys.fn_get_audit_file(N'D:\Audit\*.sqlaudit', DEFAULT, DEFAULT);</code></li>
<li>登录失败统计：<code>SELECT counter_name, cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE counter_name = N'Logins/sec' AND object_name LIKE N'%General Statistics%';</code></li>
<li>行级安全：<code>SELECT name, is_enabled, is_schema_bound FROM sys.security_policies;</code></li>
<li>动态数据掩码（2016+）：<code>SELECT OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name, name AS column_name, masking_function FROM sys.masked_columns;</code></li>
<li>敏感数据分类（2019+/SSMS）：<code>SELECT class_desc, major_id, minor_id, label, information_type FROM sys.sensitivity_classifications;</code></li>
<li>链接服务器：<code>SELECT name, product, provider, data_source, is_linked, is_remote_login_enabled, is_rpc_out_enabled FROM sys.servers WHERE server_id &lt;&gt; 0;</code></li>
<li>链接服务器登录映射：<code>SELECT s.name AS linked_server, ll.uses_self_credential, ll.remote_name FROM sys.linked_logins ll JOIN sys.servers s ON ll.server_id = s.server_id;</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="十三作业维护计划与告警461480">十三、作业、维护计划与告警（461–480）</h2>
<ol start="461">
<li>作业列表：<code>SELECT j.name, j.enabled, c.name AS category, SUSER_SNAME(j.owner_sid) AS owner, j.date_created, j.date_modified FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.syscategories c ON j.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY j.name;</code></li>
<li>禁用作业：<code>SELECT name FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs WHERE enabled = 0;</code></li>
<li>失败作业：<code>SELECT DISTINCT j.name FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON h.job_id = j.job_id WHERE h.run_status = 0 AND h.run_date &gt;= CONVERT(int, CONVERT(varchar(8), DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE()), 112));</code></li>
<li>作业失败历史：<code>SELECT j.name, h.step_id, h.step_name, h.run_status, h.run_date, h.run_time, h.message FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON h.job_id = j.job_id WHERE h.run_status = 0 ORDER BY h.run_date DESC, h.run_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>作业运行时长：<code>SELECT j.name, h.run_date, h.run_time, h.run_duration FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON h.job_id = j.job_id ORDER BY h.run_duration DESC;</code></li>
<li>作业调度：<code>SELECT j.name, s.name AS schedule_name, s.enabled, s.freq_type, s.freq_interval, s.freq_subday_type, s.freq_subday_interval FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobschedules js ON j.job_id = js.job_id JOIN msdb.dbo.sysschedules s ON js.schedule_id = s.schedule_id;</code></li>
<li>作业下次运行时间：<code>SELECT j.name, js.next_run_date, js.next_run_time FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobschedules js ON j.job_id = js.job_id ORDER BY js.next_run_date, js.next_run_time;</code></li>
<li>作业所有者：<code>SELECT name, SUSER_SNAME(owner_sid) AS owner FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs ORDER BY owner;</code></li>
<li>作业步骤：<code>SELECT j.name AS job_name, s.step_id, s.step_name, s.subsystem, s.command FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps s ON j.job_id = s.job_id ORDER BY j.name, s.step_id;</code></li>
<li>作业目标服务器：<code>SELECT j.name, ts.server_name FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobservers js ON j.job_id = js.job_id JOIN msdb.dbo.systargetservers ts ON js.server_id = ts.server_id;</code></li>
<li>维护计划：<code>SELECT name, enabled, date_created, date_modified FROM msdb.dbo.sysmaintplan_plans;</code></li>
<li>维护计划历史：<code>SELECT plan_name, start_time, end_time, succeeded FROM msdb.dbo.sysmaintplan_log ORDER BY start_time DESC;</code></li>
<li>索引重建作业：<code>SELECT j.name, j.enabled FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps s ON j.job_id = s.job_id WHERE s.command LIKE N'%REBUILD%' OR s.command LIKE N'%REORGANIZE%';</code></li>
<li>统计更新作业：<code>SELECT j.name, j.enabled FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps s ON j.job_id = s.job_id WHERE s.command LIKE N'%UPDATE STATISTICS%';</code></li>
<li>备份作业：<code>SELECT j.name, j.enabled FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps s ON j.job_id = s.job_id WHERE s.command LIKE N'%BACKUP%';</code></li>
<li>告警配置：<code>SELECT name, severity, message_id, enabled, delay_between_responses, last_occurrence_date, occurrence_count FROM msdb.dbo.sysalerts ORDER BY name;</code></li>
<li>操作员：<code>SELECT name, enabled, email_address, pager_address, netsend_address FROM msdb.dbo.sysoperators;</code></li>
<li>告警通知：<code>SELECT a.name AS alert_name, o.name AS operator_name, n.notification_method FROM msdb.dbo.sysnotifications n JOIN msdb.dbo.sysalerts a ON n.alert_id = a.id JOIN msdb.dbo.sysoperators o ON n.operator_id = o.id;</code></li>
<li>数据库邮件配置：<code>EXEC msdb.dbo.sysmail_help_configure_sp;</code></li>
<li>数据库邮件日志：<code>SELECT mailitem_id, recipients, subject, sent_status, send_request_date FROM msdb.dbo.sysmail_allitems ORDER BY mailitem_id DESC;</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="十四windows--linux-系统层运维481500">十四、Windows / Linux 系统层运维（481–500）</h2>
<ol start="481">
<li>Windows 服务状态：<code>Get-Service -Name 'MSSQL*','SQLSERVERAGENT','SQLBrowser','SQLWriter' | Format-Table Name,Status,StartType</code></li>
<li>Windows 进程资源：<code>Get-Process sqlservr | Select-Object Id,CPU,WorkingSet64,StartTime</code></li>
<li>Windows CPU 计数器：<code>Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time','\System\Processor Queue Length' -SampleInterval 1 -MaxSamples 5</code></li>
<li>Windows 内存计数器：<code>Get-Counter '\Memory\Available MBytes','\Memory\Pages/sec','\Memory\Committed Bytes' -SampleInterval 1 -MaxSamples 5</code></li>
<li>Windows 磁盘计数器：<code>Get-Counter '\PhysicalDisk(_Total)\Avg. Disk sec/Read','\PhysicalDisk(_Total)\Avg. Disk sec/Write','\PhysicalDisk(_Total)\Current Disk Queue Length' -SampleInterval 1 -MaxSamples 5</code></li>
<li>Windows 事件日志：<code>Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddHours(-24)} -MaxEvents 200</code></li>
<li>Windows 端口与连接：<code>Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1433 -State Listen; netstat -ano | findstr :1433</code></li>
<li>Windows 卷与磁盘：<code>Get-Volume | Format-Table DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,Size,SizeRemaining; Get-PhysicalDisk | Format-Table FriendlyName,MediaType,HealthStatus</code></li>
<li>Windows 故障转移集群：<code>Get-ClusterNode; Get-ClusterGroup; Get-ClusterResource | Where-Object ResourceType -eq 'SQL Server'</code></li>
<li>Windows 备份目录与校验：<code>Get-ChildItem 'D:\Backup' -Recurse | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 Name,Length,LastWriteTime; Get-FileHash 'D:\Backup\YourDB_FULL.bak' -Algorithm SHA256</code></li>
<li>Linux 服务状态：<code>sudo systemctl status mssql-server --no-pager; sudo systemctl status mssql-launchpadd --no-pager</code></li>
<li>Linux 进程资源：<code>ps -eo pid,ppid,pcpu,pmem,rss,etime,cmd | grep -i '[s]qlservr'; pidstat -p $(pgrep -f sqlservr | head -1) 1 5</code></li>
<li>Linux CPU 与内存：<code>lscpu; free -m; vmstat 1 5; top -b -n1 -o %CPU | head -20</code></li>
<li>Linux 磁盘 IO：<code>iostat -x 1 5; sar -d 1 5</code></li>
<li>Linux 磁盘空间：<code>df -h; df -i; lsblk; findmnt; du -sh /var/opt/mssql/*</code></li>
<li>Linux 端口与连接：<code>ss -tulnp | grep 1433; lsof -i :1433</code></li>
<li>Linux 日志：<code>sudo journalctl -u mssql-server -n 200 --no-pager; sudo tail -n 200 /var/opt/mssql/log/errorlog</code></li>
<li>Linux mssql-conf 配置：<code>sudo /opt/mssql/bin/mssql-conf get memory.memorylimitmb; cat /var/opt/mssql/mssql.conf</code></li>
<li>Linux 内核与 OOM：<code>sudo dmesg -T | grep -iE 'oom|killed process'; sudo sysctl vm.swappiness; ulimit -a</code></li>
<li>Linux 时间同步与权限：<code>timedatectl; chronyc tracking; ls -l /var/opt/mssql/data /var/opt/mssql/log; sudo getenforce 2&gt;/dev/null; sudo firewall-cmd --list-all 2&gt;/dev/null</code></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 id="使用提示">使用提示</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>版本差异</strong>：<code>sys.dm_db_log_info</code>、<code>sys.dm_db_log_stats</code> 需 2016 SP2+；<code>sys.dm_db_stats_histogram</code> 需 2016 SP1 CU2+；<code>sys.masked_columns</code> 需 2016+；Query Store 需 2016+；<code>ACCELERATED_DATABASE_RECOVERY</code> 需 2019+；Linux 版从 SQL Server 2017 起提供。</li>
<li><strong>批量执行</strong>：可将同类语句放入 <code>.sql</code> 文件，用 <code>sqlcmd -S &lt;实例&gt; -E -i check.sql -o result.txt</code> 执行；Linux 使用 <code>/opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -C</code>。</li>
<li><strong>权限要求</strong>：DMV 一般需 <code>VIEW SERVER STATE</code>，数据库级 DMV 需 <code>VIEW DATABASE STATE</code>，备份历史需 <code>msdb</code> 相应角色权限。</li>
<li><strong>高风险操作</strong>：<code>DBCC SHRINKFILE</code>、<code>RESTORE</code>、<code>ALTER DATABASE</code>、<code>sp_configure</code> 建议在变更窗口执行并先备份。</li>
</ul>


</div>
